sources.title: FORD LTL 9000_engine start and idle.wav
sources.author: YellowJacketStudios
sources.description: This recording is the engine starting and idling of a 1980s FORD LTL 9000 diesel semi tractor. In the middle you hear the truck door slam shut. Recorded with a Rode NTG3 and a Zoom F8 field recorder.
sources.selection: Heavy 1980s American diesel truck start, avoiding the later door slam.

sources.title: Motorcycle - Harley Davidson vintage
sources.author: Vrymaa
sources.description:
Starting an old Harley-Davidson motorcycle. Exhaust sound.
* No background noise.
* No reverb nor echo.
* Clean sound, close range. Recorded with Iphone 8 or Thomann micro t.bone SC 420.
sources.selection: Close vintage Harley-Davidson start, without street traffic.
